amenities.description: Keep only listings that have every selected amenity.
amenities.title: Required Amenities

bathrooms.description: Only include listings with exactly this many bathrooms. Combines with Minimum Bathrooms.
bathrooms.title: Exact Bathrooms

bedrooms.description: Only include listings with exactly this many bedrooms (0 = studio). Combines with Minimum Bedrooms.
bedrooms.title: Exact Bedrooms

city.description: City name to search for rentals (e.g. 'Phoenix', 'New York'). Required unless `startUrls` is provided.
city.title: City

includeDetails.description: Fetch each property page to add square footage, itemized fees, house rules, utilities, bed/bath details, and ratings. Adds one request per listing and is slower.
includeDetails.title: Fetch Full Property Details

includeReviews.description: Try to extract individual review text, ratings, and dates when FurnishedFinder embeds them in the property page. Note: only a small fraction of FurnishedFinder properties expose reviews in the page payload — most only expose `avgRating` and `totalReviewCount`. The rating/count fields are extracted regardless of this toggle when present.
includeReviews.title: Include Reviews

maxItems.description: Maximum number of listings to scrape
maxItems.title: Max Items

minBathrooms.description: Only include listings with at least this many bathrooms.
minBathrooms.title: Minimum Bathrooms

minBedrooms.description: Only include listings with at least this many bedrooms.
minBedrooms.title: Minimum Bedrooms

minBeds.description: Only include listings with at least this many individual beds.
minBeds.title: Minimum Beds

moreDetails.description: Extract landlord name, biography, profile image, verification status, and nearby hospitals from the property page.
moreDetails.title: Fetch Landlord Details

moveInDate.description: Target move-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format
moveInDate.title: Move-in Date

moveOutDate.description: Target move-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Used with Move-in Date to keep only listings available for the whole stay.
moveOutDate.title: Move-out Date

privateBathroom.description: Only include listings with a private bathroom.
privateBathroom.title: Private Bathroom

propertyType.description: Filter by property type. FurnishedFinder only exposes two filter classes: 'room' (private room in a shared place) and 'entire_unit' (whole apartment/house/condo). The granular type (House, Condo, Apartment) appears in the output `propertyType` field of every record.
propertyType.title: Property Type

proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy configuration. Apify Proxy (datacenter) is enabled by default — FurnishedFinder uses Cloudflare which blocks plain datacenter requests without proxy rotation.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

sleeps.description: Only include listings that sleep at least this many guests.
sleeps.title: Minimum Sleeps

startUrls.description: Override city/state with explicit FurnishedFinder URLs — search pages or /property/{id}_{unit} URLs. When set, city and state are ignored. If a property page is blocked from cloud IPs, the actor falls back to the newest Internet Archive (Wayback Machine) snapshot and labels the record with `dataSource: "wayback"` and `archivedAt`.
startUrls.title: Start URLs (optional)

state.description: US state — full name (e.g. 'Arizona') or two-letter code (e.g. 'AZ'). Required unless `startUrls` is provided.
state.title: State

utilitiesIncluded.description: Only include listings where utilities are included in the rent.
utilitiesIncluded.title: Utilities Included
